decisive_join: Determine whether contextual competence was translated into portable role-fit infrastructure and identify which deployment-specific authorship fields remain unrecovered.

findings.claim: A reform aimed at contextual competence was progressively compressed into portable traits, dictionaries, benchmarks, and person-job fit infrastructure.
limits: The finding does not imply every competency framework or assessment lacks value.

findings.claim: Vendorization distributes authorship: the vendor supplies instrument, norm, constructs, and report architecture while the employer authors role profile, threshold, sequence, overrides, and final judgment.
limits: The exact division must be recovered for each deployment; this wave does not assign liability.

findings.claim: Global scale and commercial value are independently supported, but they do not establish predictive validity, fairness, or causal use in a particular employer decision.
limits: Vendor claims remain vendor claims; employer-specific custody is absent.

observations.notes: The competency movement began as a critique of abstract and status-loaded measures.
observations.subject: McClelland competence reform
observations.value: real-world competence rather than intelligence or credential proxy

observations.notes: Historical diffusion converted an intensive contextual method into reusable instrumentation.
observations.subject: Competency management diffusion

observations.notes: The vendor represented assessment as a global data and delivery infrastructure.
observations.subject: SHL assessment estate

observations.notes: The vendor architecture converts responses into a role-comparison object.
observations.subject: SHL OPQ and JobMatch

observations.notes: The assessment stack existed as a valuable transferable commercial business.
observations.subject: CEB Talent Assessment transaction

observations.notes: No local role profile, instrument version, norm, threshold, sequence, override, report, or final decision rule is recovered.
observations.subject: Employer-specific deployment

selection_rule: Separate reform origin, historical diffusion, vendor representations, commercial infrastructure, and employer-specific deployment facts.

prohibited_inferences: vendor report is the final decision owner
a specific employer used an unrecovered threshold

title: Competency compression, vendor scale, and distributed authorship
